aggregation_note: Session score = mean of per-flow calibrated probabilities (prob) within each capture.
threshold_selection_description: review_threshold = p95 of benign session scores on val split; block_threshold = max benign session score (zero benign-block-FPR on val). Validation data only — no test-set contamination.
block_threshold_basis: max benign session score (zero block-FPR on val)

explanation_templates.PASS: Score below review threshold (score < 0.027090). Traffic pattern consistent with benign baseline.
explanation_templates.FLAG_REVIEW: Score is in the uncertainty band (0.027090 ≤ score < 0.165365). Elevated but not definitively VPN. Manual review recommended.
explanation_templates.SIMULATED_BLOCK: Score exceeds block threshold (score ≥ 0.165365). High-confidence VPN detection. [SIMULATED BLOCK — no real packet blocking. Simulation-only prototype.]

domain_shift_rationale: Under domain shift, unknown-domain flows produce elevated but uncertain scores in the [review_threshold, block_threshold] band. FLAG_REVIEW routes these for human inspection instead of automatic binary BLOCK, reducing risky decisions in uncertain regions.
disclaimer: SIMULATION ONLY. No real packets are blocked. All SIMULATED_BLOCK decisions are audit/log actions. This prototype is not production-ready (domain_auc=1.0, structural fingerprinting unresolved).
note: Thresholds derived from val split only (100 benign + 1 VPN sessions). Should be recomputed if a richer validation set becomes available.
